title: Forked integration case runners never run the leak check
summary: parallel_case_runner.h runs every case in a forked child that ends with _exit(), so LeakSanitizer never runs and ASAN_OPTIONS=detect_leaks=1 sanitizer runs of the scheduler and other suites report no leaks whatever happens. With an explicit __lsan_do_recoverable_leak_check() after each scheduler case, the only remaining report is the framework escape buffer, FND-20261113004147-cf2e-indigo-xml-escape-buffer-finding-001. Next: after that is fixed, run the leak check in the case runner child before _exit() where LeakSanitizer is available.
evidence: indigo_test/integration/parallel_case_runner.h _exit(runner->child(...)); per-case leak check experiment recorded in the task verification.md.
